g.title: G
g.text: Mercury client contract matrix — REQUIRED vs RECOMMENDED vs TOLERATED, by feature

g.title: layout
g.text: ack timing jitter absorbed by bitmap
Use Nub request/reply table when expecting replies
Message descriptors registered with messages.cpp wire IDs;
createBasePlayer 6 B / createCellPlayer 32 B (Y/Z rot swap);
within a bundle — client buffers and replays
forcedPosition 49 B (offsets 24-35 are prev-position ref, not velocity)
restoreClientAck emitted if restoreClient is used;
MachineGuard responses if MachineGuard is used
restoreClient not exercised in normal play;
Packed-string encoding on AUTHENTICATE session key;

Source: §2.4 (REQUIRED), §2.5 (TOLERATED), §2.6 (RECOMMENDED). The right-hand columns are where a reimplementation has freedom; the left-hand column is the contract surface. Em-dash entries indicate no freedom on that axis for that feature.
